about.title: One team, from the first message to take-down
paragraphs: Since 2022, sA Luxury Event has been decorating weddings and parties around Montpellier, from Sète to the Thau lagoon, and as far as Nice and Perpignan.
Fresh flowers, fine tableware, thrones, arches and furniture all come in one service: a consistent look, one contact, and no extra florist to coordinate.
Her work ends when the doors open. The room is ready, and the bride discovers her setting with her guests.
about.quote: “I almost never attend the weddings, even when my clients kindly invite me.”
about.quoteBy: The founder of sA Luxury Event
about.photoAlt: White calla lily bouquet tied with an “Always and forever” ribbon bearing the couple’s initials

items.q: How far in advance should we book?
items.a: As early as you can: Saturdays from May to September go quickly. Write to us as soon as you have your date and venue, even if nothing else is decided. 2027 dates are open.
Yes, our team sets up and takes down. Timing is agreed with your venue and detailed in the quote.

items.q: Are decor items hired or bought?
items.a: Furniture, tableware, thrones and decor are lent for the event. Floral arrangements and the bridal bouquet are made for you.

items.q: Do you travel beyond Montpellier, Nice and Perpignan?
items.a: Yes, across the South and further depending on dates. Give the town of your venue in the form: any travel costs are shown in the quote.
A deposit secures your date. The amount and terms are shown on the quote.
Yes. After the first conversation we meet to build the moodboard: colours, flowers, textures and the room layout.
Yes, a decoration and catering package is possible with our partners. Just mention it in your message.
Yes. Fill in the form or message us on WhatsApp and we’ll come back to you with a proposal.

The quote form stores nothing on this website: it prepares a message that you send yourself on WhatsApp. The details you share are only used to answer your request. You can ask for them to be deleted at any time by WhatsApp or phone.
